collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a child aged 5-10 and an adult)

collection.description: A child wants to join a beach game but is afraid to ask: offer to walk over together, or ask what the child would like.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The other children are playing a game on the beach that (subject) doesn't know. (subject.He/she) is standing at the edge, watching. (subject.He/she) wants to join in, and is afraid to ask, in case they say no, or laugh, or (subject.he/she) does it wrong. (friend) notices (subject.him/her) standing there.

choices.label: Ask What (subject.he/she) Would Like to Do

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Want me to come with you?" asks (friend). (subject) nods. They walk over together, and (friend) asks the children what the game is. They explain, all at once. Someone says, "You can be on our side." (subject) is still nervous, but (subject.he/she) runs off to play, and (friend) watches from a distance.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "Do you want to join, or just watch?" asks (friend). (subject) thinks about it. "Watch," (subject.he/she) says. "So I learn it first." They sit and watch together. (subject) figures out the rules. The next day, (subject.he/she) walks up to the game all by (subject.him/her)self. It's still a little frightening. (subject.He/she) does it anyway.
